changes.title: Records for batches 28 to 30: handoff, closeout note, feature status
changes.detail: Documentation only. Says what landed in the last three batches and, for each part, exactly how far it was checked and what was never seen. The records were three batches behind, which is a long time for a file whose whole job is to be current.
changes.detail_yue: 紀錄補返第 28 至 30 批：交接、收尾提示同功能狀態。只係文件，寫清楚每樣 嘢驗到邊度、邊樣未見過。紀錄落後咗三批，一個專登用嚟「最新」嘅檔案落後 成咁，都幾諷刺。

changes.title: Image store folders, download/rename/convert in Manage, dim sum surprise
changes.detail:
Batch 30. The image store learns what a folder is, the Manage dialog learns that people sometimes want their files back, and one launch in ten now greets you with a dumpling.

- Image store folders: create, open, rename, move, remove (images move up, none is deleted). Image ids, files on disk and serve addresses are unchanged, so pictures already used elsewhere keep working. Uploads go into the folder being looked at. Server tests: 177 passed. Driven in a local build at 1440, 390 and 320 px. - Manage, for media and images: download one item, download a selection as a zip (up to 200 MB), edit a name, convert with the built-in converter into a new item beside the original. The convert dialog's format choice is a proper radio group built from buttons (this last change is lint and unit-test checked only). - Dim sum surprise: one fresh draw per launch, shown one time in ten, as a small card that never takes focus. The settings switch cannot be turned off. School mode hides it. One single-item download in ten arrives as a zip with the file unchanged plus a dish picture, and says so. Pictures come only from the public catalogue through a new small server component; nothing is bundled. Ser
changes.detail_yue: 第 30 批。圖片庫終於識咩叫資料夾；管理視窗明白人有時想攞返自己啲檔案， 可以下載、改名、轉檔；而十次開機有一次會有件點心出嚟同你打招呼，個開關 熄極都熄唔到，呢個係功能，唔係故障。點心相只會由公開目錄攞，伺服器自己 去攞同存低，源碼入面一張相都冇。卡片係迫住抽中先見到，真正隨機抽中嗰次 未親眼見過，照直講。

changes.title: Finish editor search, upload limits and conversion, add media on phones
changes.detail:
Batch 29. The three pieces the last commit called unfinished are now finished and were driven in a local build.

- Automation and script editor: a search bar across every step at any depth with match count and next/previous, a search on every nested list, and a filter by the entities the automation uses. The search bar was tightened after the browser pass so it stops eating a phone screen. - Uploads: 2 GB for the media library and 50 MB for the image store, with a percentage while uploading; dropped pictures the image store cannot take are converted, oversized ones are re-encoded to fit and the loss is stated. Server tests for both upload endpoints: 151 passed. - "Add media" for phones: the Pages sheet menu now has the entry, so a device that cannot drag can still add files. That one entry is unit tested only. - Records: changelog and the automation feature index.

Image store folder work in progress in the tree is deliberately left out of this commit.

Checks: type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors; full suite 6,824 passed with the 3 known build-script failures.
changes.detail_yue: 第 29 批。上一個提交話未做完嗰三樣，而家做完喇，仲喺本機 build 入面跑過。 自動化編輯器有搜尋、每個巢狀清單都有自己嘅搜尋、仲可以按用到嘅實體篩選； 上載放寬到 2 GB 同 50 MB，唔啱格式嘅圖會自動轉；手機拖唔到嘢，所以頁面 選單加咗「加入媒體」。圖片資料夾仲做緊，今次特登唔放入嚟。
